project.docs/retries.md:
# Retries

A call that works returns its value unchanged.

```ts check
import { retry } from 'acme-client';
assert.equal(await retry(async () => 'ok'), 'ok');
```

Tried at most `3` times. <!-- fact: RETRY.maxAttempts -->

The client reads these variables:

<!-- fact: ENV_KEYS -->
- `API_TOKEN`
- `REGION`

The wait doubles each time.

<!-- cases: backoff -->
| case       | attempt | result |
|------------|---------|--------|
| first try  | 1       | 200    |
| second try | 2       | 400    |
| third try  | 3       | 800    |

A call that keeps failing throws the last error. <!-- test: test/retry.test.ts > "throws the last error" -->

Error codes:

- `TIMEOUT`
- `RATE_LIMITED`

from the code, tables whose rows run. `npx --no docattest check` runs every proof and fails at the

- **After you edit source code**, run `npx --no docattest impact --file <path>` with the path of
  the file you edited. It prints the documented exports your change affects and every page
  and line that describes them, and prints nothing when there are none. Read the lines it
  lists and bring them up to date with the code.
- **Before you finish**, run `npx --no docattest check`. If it fails, make the page true again or
  fix the code. Never delete or weaken a claim to make it pass.

`npx --no docattest where <symbol>` lists the pages that describe an export.

the two markers. Write your own notes outside them.
